name: Yuukyou Gangu Rebirth
source:
Lawyer agrees to abandon her suit if the girl under trial agrees to be her "slave" for a month. There can't be slaves in the 21st century, so girl understands it as doing chores and driving to the work, and thus agrees. Soon she will know the true meaning behind being a slave.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女律师答应撤回诉讼，条件是受审的女孩同意做她一个月的“奴隶”。女孩觉得21世纪不可能真的还有奴隶，便以为对方只是要自己做些杂务、开车接送她上班，于是接受了条件。用不了多久，她就会明白“奴隶”二字背后的真正含义。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
